scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @earthquake/backend" "npm run dev -w @earthquake/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @earthquake/shared-types && npm run build -w @earthquake/shared-utils && npm run build -w @earthquake/backend && npm run build -w @earthquake/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @earthquake/shared-types && npm run lint -w @earthquake/shared-utils && npm run lint -w @earthquake/backend && npm run lint -w @earthquake/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @earthquake/shared-utils && npm run test -w @earthquake/backend && npm run test -w @earthquake/frontend
scripts.generate:geology-layers: npm run generate:fault-layers && npm run generate:trench-layers && npm run generate:volcano-layers
